name: Amalric Aredo
found: The Wind-Lofts at Carnaxe, turning the legs.
appearance: Heavy, salt-cracked hands, a Lucernian cut to his coat.
and_yet: Smells of juniper, never of meat.
sayings: A leg is ready when it tells you. Not before.
does_not_want: The militia telling him whose game to buy.
family: Wife Beronia, who keeps the cure; grown sons who work the lofts.
